mapper.select: select c.title as title, m.plays as plays, m.completion_rate as completionRate from heron_news_metric m join heron_video_version v on v.version_id = m.version_id join heron_news_work w on w.work_id = v.work_id join heron_news_candidate c on c.candidate_id = w.candidate_id where m.fetched_at = ( select max(m2.fetched_at) from heron_news_metric m2 where m2.version_id = m.version_id) order by m.fetched_at desc limit #{limit}

select
coalesce(json_unquote(json_extract(v.input_snapshot, '$.selection.templateId')), '未记录') as bucket
coalesce(json_unquote(json_extract(v.input_snapshot, '$.editorial.line')), '未记录') as bucket
coalesce(nullif(json_unquote(json_extract(v.input_snapshot, '$.editorial.storyAngle')), ''), '未记录') as bucket
, count(*) as samples , avg(m.plays) as avgPlays , avg(m.completion_rate) as avgCompletionRate , avg(m.likes) as avgLikes , max(m.plays) as maxPlays from heron_news_metric m join heron_video_version v on v.version_id = m.version_id where m.fetched_at = ( select max(m2.fetched_at) from heron_news_metric m2 where m2.version_id = m.version_id) and m.plays is not null group by bucket having count(*) > 0 order by avgCompletionRate desc, avgPlays desc
